options.text: No.

black-arm-gang-talking-to-katrine.speaker: Katrine
black-arm-gang-talking-to-katrine.text: It's a private business. Can I help you at all?

options.text: I've heard you're the Black Arm Gang

steps.player: I've heard you're the Black Arm Gang.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Who told you that?

options.text: I'd rather not reveal my sources.

steps.player: I'd rather not reveal my sources.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Yes, I can understand that. So what do you want with us?

options.text: I want to become a member of your gang.

steps.player: I want to become a member of your gang.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: How unusual.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Normally we recruit for our gang by watching local thugs and thieves in action. People don't normally waltz in here saying 'hello, can I play'.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: How can I be sure you can be trusted?

options.text: Well, you can give me a try can't you?

steps.player: Well, you can give me a try can't you?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: I'm not so sure.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Thinking about it... I may have a solution actually.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Our rival gang - the Phoenix Gang - has a weapons stash a little east of here.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: We're fresh out of crossbows, so if you could steal a couple of crossbows for us it would be very much appreciated.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Then I'll be happy to call you a Black Arm.

steps.player: Sounds simple enough. Any particular reason you need two of them?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: I have an idea for framing a local merchant who is refusing to pay our, very reasonable, 'keep-your-life-pleasant' insurance rates. I need two phoenix crossbows; one to kill somebody important with and the other to

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: hide in the merchant's house where the local law can find it! When they find it, they'll suspect him of murdering the target for the Phoenix Gang and, hopefully, arrest the whole gang! Leaving us as the only

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: thieves gang in Varrock! Brilliant, eh?

steps.player: Yeah, brilliant. So who are you planning to murder?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: I haven't decided yet, but it'll need to be somebody important. Say, why are you being so nosey? You aren't with the law are you?

steps.player: No, no! Just curious.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: You'd better just keep your mouth shut about this plan, or I'll make sure it stays shut for you. Now, are you going to go get those crossbows or not?

options.text: Ok, no problem.

steps.player: Ok, no problem.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Great! You'll find the Phoenix gang's weapon stash just next to a temple, due east of here.

options.text: Sounds a little tricky. Got anything easier?

steps.player: Sounds a little tricky...
Got anything easier?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: If you're not up to a little bit of danger I don't think you've got anything to offer our gang.

options.text: Well, people tell me I have an honest face.

steps.player: Well, people tell me I have an honest face!

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: ... How unusual. Someone honest wanting to join a gang of thieves. Excuse me if I remain unconvinced.
Continues from "Thinking about it... I may have a solution actually."

options.text: I want some hints for becoming a thief.

steps.player: I want some hints for becoming a thief.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Well, I'm sorry luv, I'm not giving away any of my secrets.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Not to people who ain't Black Arm members anyway.

options.text: I'm looking for the door out of here.

steps.player: I'm looking for the door out of here.

steps.text: Katrine groans.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Try...the one you just came in?

options.text: It was Charlie, the tramp outside.

steps.player: It was Charlie, the tramp outside.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Is that guy still out there? He's getting to be a nuisance. Remind me to send someone to kill him.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: So now you've found us, what do you want?
Continues after "Yes, I can understand that. So what do you want with us?"

options.text: Everyone knows - it's no great secret.

steps.player: Everyone knows. It's no great secret.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: I thought we were safe back here!

steps.player: Oh no, not at all... It's so obvious! Even the town guard have caught on...

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Wow! We MUST be obvious! I guess they'll be expecting bribes again soon in that case.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Thanks for the information.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: Is there anything else you want to tell me?
Continues after "Yes, I can understand that. So what do you want with us?"

options.text: What sort of business?

steps.player: What sort of business?

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: A small, family business. We give financial advice to other companies.

options.text: I'm looking for fame and riches.

steps.player: I'm looking for fame and riches.

steps.speaker: Katrine
steps.text: And you expect to find it up the back streets of Varrock?

options.text: Sorry, I haven't got any.

Ok. Here you go.

steps.text: I guess that'll have to do then.

steps.text: Great, thanks.

steps.player: So where is the hideout then?

options.text: You theiving gutter-scum! You'd better watch your back!

steps.player: You theiving gutter-scum! You'd better watch your back!

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: Yeah, sure, whatever. You don't frighten me, pal.

options.text: That's not fair, but I guess I don't have a choice.

5 gold

steps.text: Great, thanks.

options.text: I think I know where the hideout is, but I can't get inside.

steps.player: I think I know where the hideout is, but I can't get inside. Any ideas?

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: Hmmm. I dunno.

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: Your best bet would probably be to find someone else... Someone who ISN'T a member of the Black Arm Gang, and get them to infiltrate the ranks of the Phoenix Gang for you.

options.text: Ok. Good plan!

steps.player: Ok. Good plan!

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: I'm not just a pretty face!

steps.speaker: Charlie the Tramp
steps.text: There's plenty of other adventurers about besides yourself. I'm sure if you asked one of them nicely they would help you.

steps.text: Sh sh sh, not so loud! You don't want to get me in trouble!

steps.speaker: Baraek
steps.text: Ok, to get to the gang hideout, enter Varrock through the south gate. Then, if you take the first turning east, somewhere along there is an alleyway to the south. The door at the end of there is the entrance to the Phoenix

steps.speaker: Baraek
steps.text: Gang. They're operating there under the name of the VTAM Corporation. Be careful. The Phoenixes ain't the types to be messed about.

steps.player: Thanks!

phoenix-gang-talking-to-straven.text: Hey! You can't go in there. Only authorised personnel of the VTAM Corporation are allowed beyond this point.

options.text: I know who you are!

steps.player: I know who you are!

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Really.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Well?

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Who are we then?

steps.player: This is the headquarters of the Phoenix Gang, the most powerful crime syndicate this city has ever seen!

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: No, this is a legitimate business run by legitimate businessmen.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Supposing we were this crime gang however, what would you want with us?

options.text: I'd like to offer you my services.

steps.player: I'd like to offer you my services.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: You mean you'd like to join the Phoenix Gang?

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Well, obviously I can't speak for them, but the Phoenix Gang doesn't let people join just like that.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: You can't be too careful, you understand.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Generally someone has to prove their loyalty before they can join.

steps.player: How would I go about doing that?

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Obviously, I would have no idea about that.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Although having said that, a rival gang of ours, er, theirs, called the Black Arm Gang is supposedly meeting a contact from Port Sarim today in the Blue Moon Inn.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: The Blue Moon Inn is just by the south entrance to this city, and supposedly the name of the contact is Jonny the Beard.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: OBVIOUSLY I know NOTHING about the dealings of the Phoenix Gang, but I bet if SOMEBODY were to kill him and bring back his intelligence report, they would be considered loyal enough to join.

steps.player: Ok, I'll get right on it.

options.text: I want nothing. I was just making sure you were them.

steps.player: I want nothing. I was just making sure you were them.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Well, then get lost and stop wasting my time.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: ...if you know what's good for you.

options.text: How do I get a job with the VTAM corporation?

steps.player: How do I get a job with the VTAM corporation?

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Get a copy of the Varrock Herald. If we have any positions right now, they'll be advertised in there.

options.text: Why not?

steps.player: Why not?

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Sorry. That's classified information.

steps.player: I haven't managed to find the report yet...

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: You need to kill Jonny the Beard, who should be in the Blue Moon Inn.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: ...I would guess. Not being a member of the Phoenix Gang and all.

steps.text: I'll wait here.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Yes. Yes, this is very good. Very well, then! You can join the Phoenix Gang! I am Straven, one of the gang leaders.

steps.player: Nice to meet you.

steps.text: intel report

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: You now have access to the inner sanctum of our subterranean hideout, and our weapons supply depot round the front of this building.

options.text: I've heard you've got some cool treasures in this place.

steps.player: I've heard you've got some cool treasures in this place...

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Oh yeah, we've all stolen some stuff in our time. Those candlesticks down here, for example, were quite a challenge to get out of the palace.

steps.player: And the shield of Arrav? I heard you got that!

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Woah... that's a blast from the past! We stole that years and years ago! We don't even have all the shield anymore.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: About five years ago we had a massive fight in our gang and the shield got broken in half during that fight.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Shortly after that fight some gang members decided they didn't want to be part of our gang anymore. So they split off to form their own gang.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: The Black Arm Gang.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: On their way out they looted what treasures they could from us - which included one of the halves of the shield. We've been rivals with the Black Arms ever since.

options.text: Any suggestions for where I can go thieving?

steps.player: Any suggestions for where I can go thieving?

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: You can always try the marketplace in Ardougne. LOTS of opportunity there!

options.text: Where's the Black Arm Gang hideout?

steps.player: Where's the Black Arm Gang hideout? I wanna go sabotage 'em!

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: That would be a little tricky; their security is pretty good.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: Not as good as ours, obviously.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: But still good.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: If you really want to go there, it's in the alleyway to the west as you come in the south gate.

steps.speaker: Straven
steps.text: One of our operatives is often near the alley - a red haired tramp, goes by the name of Charlie. He may be able to give you some ideas.

steps.player: Thanks for the help!

phoenix-gang-talking-to-straven-after-lo.speaker: Straven
phoenix-gang-talking-to-straven-after-lo.text: You really need to be more careful. We don't want that key falling into the wrong hands. Ah well... Have this spare. Don't lose THIS one.

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.text: Welcome to the museum of Varrock.

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.player: I have half the shield of Arrav here. Can I get a reward?

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.text: The Shield of Arrav! Goodness, the Museum has been searching for that for years! The late King Roald II offered a reward for it years ago!

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.player: Well, I'm here to claim it.

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.text: Let me have a look at it first.

steps.text: The curator peers at the shield.

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.text: That shield has been missing for over twenty-five years!

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.text: Leave the shield here with me and I'll write you out a certificate saying that you have returned the shield, so that you can claim your reward from the King.

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.player: Can I have two certificates please?

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.text: Yes, certainly. Please hand over the shield.

steps.text: You hand over the shield half.
The curator writes out two half-certificates.

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.text: Of course you won't actually be able to claim the reward with only half the reward certificates...

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.player: What? I went through a lot of trouble to get that shield piece and now you tell me it was for nothing? That's not very fair!

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.speaker: Curator Haig Halen
finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.text: Well, if you were to get me the other half of the shield, I could give you the other half of the reward certificate. It's rumoured to be in the possession of the infamous Blackarm Gang, beyond that I can't help you.

finishing-up-talking-to-curator-haig-hal.player: Okay, I'll see what I can do.

finishing-up-talking-to-king-roald-befor.player: Your majesty, I have recovered the Shield of Arrav; I would like to claim the reward.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: The Shield of Arrav, eh? Yes, I do recall my father, King Roald, put a reward out for that.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: Very well.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: If you get the authenticity of the shield verified by the curator at the museum and then return here with authentication, I will grant you your reward.

steps.text: You show the certificate to the king.

steps.speaker: King Roald
steps.text: I'm afraid that's only half the reward certificate. You'll have to get the other half and join them together if you want to claim the reward.

finishing-up-talking-to-king-roald-after.player: Your majesty, I have come to claim the reward for the return of the Shield Of Arrav.

finishing-up-talking-to-king-roald-after.text: You show the certificate to the king.

finishing-up-talking-to-king-roald-after.speaker: King Roald
finishing-up-talking-to-king-roald-after.text: My goodness! This claim is for the reward offered by my father many years ago!

finishing-up-talking-to-king-roald-after.speaker: King Roald
finishing-up-talking-to-king-roald-after.text: I never thought I would live to see the day when someone came forward to claim this reward!

finishing-up-talking-to-king-roald-after.speaker: King Roald
finishing-up-talking-to-king-roald-after.text: I heard that you found half the shield, so I will give you half of the bounty. That comes to exactly 600gp!
You hand over a certificate. The king gives you 600gp.

aYKnzv.player: Oh wait. I haven't got enough, sorry.
